name: Logosearch
summary: Framer plugin that finds and inserts 30M+ company logos by brand name or domain, without leaving the canvas.
description: A Framer Marketplace plugin for placing real company logos: search by company name or domain, drag logos into the canvas or replace existing image frames, pick preset sizes (32, 64, 128 px) or custom dimensions, export PNG/JPG/WEBP, and browse by category such as SaaS, crypto, social and brands. Built for landing pages, partner sections and tech-stack visuals. Powered by Logo.dev.
